newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 25.403 million bushels wheat, 23.081 million bushels of corn and 2.822 bushels of barley inspected in the week to Sept 19 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
St Lawrence Swy to:Peru 386; S Africa 676; Tunisia 284
Lakes to:Italy 666, S Africa 656, UK 663; Venezuela 112
Gulf to:Armenia 606, Colombia 386; Ecuador 636; Egypt 3,858;El Salvador 207; Ghana 81; Honduras 123; Mexico 735; Nicaragua 632; Nigeria 229; Poland 2,021; S Africa 293; Tunisia 1,010
WHEAT: Pacific to Taiwan 728; Ethopia 597; Japan 2,271; Korea 1,233; Pakistan 1,737; Philippines 1,098, Thailand 321 Korea 897; Pakistan 2,825; Thailand 1,314; Yemen 1,213.
CORN: Gulf to Taiwan 6,969; Colombia 646; Egypt 2,195; El Salvador 604; Guatemala 111; Japan 4,640; Korea 4,167; Mexico 1,148; Nicaragua 34; Syria 981
